been written to be checked. One config could not do both without either
failing on findings in code that ships and works, or shipping a dist/ with

noEmitOnError, because a dist/ built from a tree that does not compile is a
package that installs and then fails on import — the exact failure shape
scripts/check-publish.js exists to catch, arriving one step earlier.
declarationMap is off: exports[*].types names the hand-written types/, so a
map into dist/*.d.ts would lead somewhere no consumer navigates from.
